name: OpenGuardrails
description: Judge every tool call and outbound channel message through an OpenGuardrails runtime (OGR v1.0) — block enforced in place, fail-open by default; secrets masked on this host before they reach the model (OGR 1.4).

runtime.description: OpenGuardrails runtime connection and identity claims; each field falls back to OGR_* environment variables, then to "" (no assertion).

url.description: Runtime base URL (default https://openguardrails.com). A mounted prefix belongs in it.

apiKey.description: Organization API key; unset disables the runtime connection (and with it every guard).

agentId.description: agent_id claim — WHICH agent, unique in the organization.

agentType.description: agent_type claim — what KIND of agent (default "openclaw").

workspace.description: agent_workspace claim — the platform policy group, NOT a directory.

user.description: agent_user claim — who is using the assistant.

failMode.description: Degraded-mode posture when the runtime cannot answer: open (default) proceeds loudly, closed refuses the action.

guardMessages.description: Also judge outbound channel messages, not just tool calls (default true).

localRedaction.description: Local secrets redaction (OGR 1.4): mask every outbound model request at this process's HTTP client (system prompt included), restore placeholders into tool params on this host after judgement; the ingress hooks are the fallback. On by default; the ruleset is fetched from the runtime.

enabled.description: Mask at all (default true; env OGR_LOCAL_REDACTION=0|false|off turns it off).

http.description: Mask at the HTTP client — the in-process fetch/undici interceptor, the primary path (default true; env OGR_LOCAL_REDACTION_HTTP=0|false|off leaves only the ingress-hook masking).

cachePath.description: Where the fetched ruleset is cached, mode 0600 (default ~/.openguardrails/rules-<hash>.json; env OGR_RULES_CACHE).

tiers.description: Which rule tiers to mask (default both; env OGR_LOCAL_REDACTION_TIERS).
